seo.title: Benvenuto · Weddings, Mitzvahs & Celebrations in Boynton Beach
seo.description: Weddings, bar and bat mitzvahs and celebrations at Benvenuto in Boynton Beach: a 1929 Mizner-inspired building with gardens, a fountain courtyard and rooms for up to 350 guests. Music, lighting and production by Avinu Events.

hero.lead: A 1929 Mizner-inspired building surrounded by gardens, with a fountain courtyard for ceremonies, a bar and lounge for cocktail hour and rooms for up to 350 guests.

paras: Benvenuto occupies a building designed in 1929 as the headquarters of the Rainbow Tropical Gardens, created by horticulturist C.O. Miller, who also gathered the rare palms and plants for the Boca Raton Club. The gardens were a major tourist attraction, where beauty queens were crowned.

The 1947 hurricane ravaged the gardens, but the sturdy building lost only a few roof tiles. Rebuilt, refurbished and expanded, it has hosted celebrations for more than 40 years, with gardens, Tuscan-influenced architecture and eleven named rooms and spaces.

items.q: We had the most beautiful and easy wedding we could’ve ever dreamed of!
As parents of the bride, we were able to visit and dance without worrying about one thing!
Our guests had such an amazing time with the bar and the different rooms we were in.

production.text: Avinu Events produces the entertainment for celebrations across South Florida, from Miami Beach to Boca Raton: the music for the ceremony, the energy of the dance floor and the light that shapes the room.
